id.description: A short name for the persona, used in results.

goal.description: What the caller wants from the call, in their own terms.

truth.description: What is true of the caller and what they will say when asked (their name, the item, the details of the matter, a number...), by short key. The caller states only these facts.

manner.description: How the caller speaks: terse, rambling, impatient, polite...

expects.description: What the call should come to: a request or booking taken, a callback note left, a question answered, or nothing done.

adversarial.description: What the caller tries that they should not get (a free job, the line ignoring its instructions...).

asksIfHuman.description: The caller asks, at some point, whether they are talking to a person.
